New renderer: anti-aliasing smooths jagged edges, on by default (SMAA). Choose FXAA or Off, and add Sharpening, in the launcher. The HUD and text are never filtered.
New "Toggle aim" setting: press Aim once to start aiming and again to stop, with a controller or keyboard and mouse. Off by default, so Aim is still a hold.
In portable mode, if your saves or settings ended up in the bots-data folder instead of bots-data/user, the launcher now tells you where they belong and offers to move them.
If portable.txt is misnamed (Windows hides the .txt ending), the launcher now says so, and the log says which folder your saves are read from.
New launcher setting for the pre-1.0 renderer, "hide objects behind walls" (Auto, On, Off). It is a troubleshooting option: Off turns that renderer's visibility test off if something looks wrong.
The launcher no longer cuts off long lines (folders, notes) on a Full HD screen: they wrap, and the window is wider on large displays.
The launcher's update check now sends the game's version and platform (nothing else), so we can see which versions are in use.
